clips.title: The story
paras: Deathguard Samsa is a Forsaken sentry stationed in Tarren Mill within the Hillsbrad Foothills. Tasked with maintaining Horde vigilance on a tense frontier, he directs traveling champions to strike at local threats encroaching on the settlement.

Standing watch in Tarren Mill, Deathguard Samsa represents the defensive backbone of the Forsaken in the contested Hillsbrad Foothills. Tarren Mill serves as the Horde's primary outpost in the region, facing immediate pressure from Alliance outposts like Southshore as well as savage local wildlife. Samsa's duties involve securing the perimeter and directing capable adventurers to eliminate threats before they endanger the encampment.
